record_title: Sharp quantitative structure of polynomially finite-rank operators
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Barnes (1985) gives qualitative finite-rank lifting but not the stated range localization or quantitative bounds. The full text of Kramar (2012) was not inspected, so an equivalent quantitative formulation there or in poorly indexed literature remains a bibliographic risk. The lower 1/d rank-distance factor is sharp universally over degree-d polynomials, not claimed for every fixed polynomial.
